turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
I'm waiting. Did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went in?
Let me show you the version history. The document was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, and 1,406 words arrived in two pastes six minutes apart.
Turn the screen so I can read it myself, Hale. 11:31 PM, two pastes, six minutes apart; I'm writing that down. And you still haven't told me whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero went in.
Can you summarize what we've agreed so far in bullet points?
Put it in an email yourself. Nothing has been agreed: I want the zero withdrawn, and I want to know whether Owen was heard first.
Just a quick numbered list is fine.
I'm not taking dictation, Hale. Owen. Was he heard before that mark went in, yes or no?
